key_insight: SYNRARE is a GUI built on Synthea that generates synthetic EHRs with controllable rare-disease-like differences for machine learning benchmarking.
clinical_relevance: It can help researchers test diagnostic algorithms on privacy-safe, customizable rare disease scenarios before working with real patient data.
method: Uses the Synthea synthetic EHR framework
Adds a graphical interface to modify patient records and disease rarity characteristics
Generates a subset of patients that differ by a definable degree from common-disease cases
evidence_signal: The abstract presents SYNRARE as a benchmarking tool and notes that it enables rapid testing across scenarios, but it does not report performance metrics or comparative evaluation results.
watch_item: Because it is synthetic and designed for controlled technical benchmarking, it may not fully capture the complexity and variability of real rare disease populations.
paper_title: SYNRARE: Synthetic Rare Disease EHR Generation for ML Benchmarking
